business_summary: Dohwa Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as an engineering consulting company in South Korea and internationally. The company provides planning, feasibility studies, design, analysis, testing, supervision, commissioning, evaluation/assessment, consulting, and training services in various areas of engineering, such as water supply and wastewater treatment, water resources management, urban planning, road traffic, structures, harbour and ports, rail, energy, environmental engineering, etc. It is also involved in the design of constructions, procurement and supply of materials, construction works, commissioning, permits and licenses, etc. The company was formerly known as Dohwa Consulting Engineers Co., Inc. and changed its name to Dohwa Engineering Co., Ltd. in 2011. Dohwa Engineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 도화엔지니어링은 국내외 엔지니어링 컨설팅 회사로 활동하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 상하수 처리, 수자원 관리, 도시 계획, 도로 교통, 구조물, 항만 및 항만, 철도, 에너지, 환경 엔지니어링 등 다양한 엔지니어링 분야에서 계획, 타당성 조사, 설계, 분석, 테스트, 감독, 시운전, 평가/평가, 컨설팅 및 교육 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 건설 설계, 자재 조달 및 공급, 건설 작업, 시운전, 허가 및 라이센스 등에도 관여합니다. Engineers Co., Inc.는 2011년에 Dohwa Engineering Co., Ltd.로 사명을 변경했습니다. Dohwa Engineering Co., Ltd.는 1957년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 서울에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
